description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions (k) and majority voting accuracy. The x-axis, labeled 'Number of completions (k)', is on a logarithmic scale, spanning from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis, labeled 'Majority voting accuracy', is on a linear scale, ranging from 0.3 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. There are four lines in the plot: two blue lines, one with a darker shade and circular markers, and the other with a lighter shade and triangular markers; and two green lines, also with darker and lighter shades, and triangular and diamond markers, respectively. The darker blue line starts at approximately 0.45 at 2^0 and increases to around 0.62 at 2^8. The lighter blue line begins at about 0.28 at 2^0 and rises to roughly 0.43 at 2^8. The darker green line closely follows the darker blue line, with values ranging from approximately 0.45 at 2^0 to 0.63 at 2^8. The lighter green line is similar to the lighter blue line, starting at around 0.28 at 2^0 and reaching about 0.43 at 2^8. All lines exhibit an upward trend as the number of completions increases.
